DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-06-001-SHARE.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-06-001-SHARE.sourceJa: 目のことで、どのようなご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-06-001-SHARE.translation: What would you like to discuss about your eyes?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-06-001-SHARE.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-06-001-SHARE.sourceJa: 小さい表示が読みにくいです。店が暗かったからだと思いましたが、明るい所でも読みにくかったので、その違いを伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-06-001-SHARE.hintJa: 暗所だけでなく明所でも小文字が読みにくいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-06-001-SHARE.translation: Small print is hard to read. I thought it was because the shop was dark, but it was hard to read in a bright place too, so I'd like to explain that difference.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-06-001-SHARE.hintTranslation: Explain that small print is hard to read in both dark and bright places. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-06-001-SHARE.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-06-001-SHARE.sourceJa: 二つの場所では、同じ表示を見たのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-06-001-SHARE.translation: Were you looking at the same writing in the two places?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-06-001-SHARE.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-06-001-SHARE.sourceJa: 同じ包装の文字です。店内ではよく読めず、窓の近くへ移っても小さい文字ははっきりしませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-06-001-SHARE.hintJa: 同じ包装の文字を二つの明るさで見たと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-06-001-SHARE.translation: It was the writing on the same package. I couldn't read it well inside the shop, and the small letters weren't clear even after moving near a window.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-06-001-SHARE.hintTranslation: Explain that you looked at the writing on the same package under two lighting conditions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-06-001-SHARE.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-06-001-SHARE.sourceJa: その時、普段の眼鏡は使っていましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-06-001-SHARE.translation: Were you wearing your usual glasses at the time?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-06-001-SHARE.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-06-001-SHARE.sourceJa: 両方で普段の眼鏡を使っていました。いつからかは、はっきり思い出せません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-06-001-SHARE.hintJa: 普段の眼鏡を両所で使い開始時期は不明と答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-06-001-SHARE.translation: I wore my usual glasses in both places. I can't clearly remember when this started.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-06-001-SHARE.hintTranslation: Say you wore your usual glasses in both places and do not know when it began. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-06-001-SHARE.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-06-001-SHARE.sourceJa: 分かる経過と、まだ分からない所を診察でお話しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-06-001-SHARE.translation: During the consultation, please describe what you know about its course and what is still unclear.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-06-001-SHARE.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-06-001-SHARE.sourceJa: 分かりました。日常生活で困っていることも話したいです。仕事の小さい表示を読むときも、近づかないと読みにくいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-06-001-SHARE.hintJa: 仕事の小さい表示にも近づく必要があり日常の支障を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-06-001-SHARE.translation: Understood. I'd also like to explain the difficulties in everyday life. At work too, I find small labels hard to read unless I move closer.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-06-001-SHARE.hintTranslation: Explain the everyday difficulty of needing to move closer to small labels at work too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-06-001-SHARE.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-06-001-SHARE.sourceJa: 比較した包装は、お持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-06-001-SHARE.translation: Do you have the package you used for the comparison?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-06-001-SHARE.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-06-001-SHARE.sourceJa: この包装を持っています。仕事で見づらい表示の写真もありますが、診察で一緒に見せていいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-06-001-SHARE.hintJa: 比較した包装と仕事の表示写真を診察で示してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-06-001-SHARE.translation: I have this package. I also have a photo of the label that's hard to see at work. May I show both during the consultation?
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-06-001-SHARE.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may show the compared package and the photo of the workplace label during the consultation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-06-001-SHARE.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-06-001-SHARE.sourceJa: お持ちの資料も診察担当へお見せください。見え方と経過をご説明ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-06-001-SHARE.translation: Please show the medical staff the information you brought too. Explain how you see things and how it has developed.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-07-001-SHARE.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-07-001-SHARE.sourceJa: ご予約の商品のお受け取りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-07-001-SHARE.translation: Are you here to collect a reserved item?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-07-001-SHARE.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-07-001-SHARE.sourceJa: 同僚に頼まれて来ました。取り置きの菓子を受け取りたいのですが、注文した本人でなくても大丈夫ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-07-001-SHARE.hintJa: 代理で取り置き品を受け取れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-07-001-SHARE.translation: My coworker asked me to come. I'd like to collect the sweets being held, but is it all right if I'm not the person who ordered them?
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-07-001-SHARE.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can collect a held item on someone else's behalf. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-07-001-SHARE.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-07-001-SHARE.sourceJa: 確認します。ご予約のお名前や番号は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-07-001-SHARE.translation: I'll check. Do you know the reservation name or number?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-07-001-SHARE.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-07-001-SHARE.sourceJa: 名前はこちらです。番号は聞いていません。同僚から来たメッセージならお見せできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-07-001-SHARE.hintJa: 注文者名とメッセージを示し予約番号は不明と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-07-001-SHARE.translation: Here's the name. I wasn't given a number. I can show you the message from my coworker.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-07-001-SHARE.hintTranslation: Show the orderer's name and message and say you do not know the reservation number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-07-001-SHARE.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-07-001-SHARE.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。こちらの箱で合っているか、ご本人に確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-07-001-SHARE.translation: Thank you. Can you check with the person who ordered whether this is the right box?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-07-001-SHARE.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-07-001-SHARE.sourceJa: はい。頼まれたのは二箱だと思っていましたが、このメッセージには個数が書いていません。電話で聞いてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-07-001-SHARE.hintJa: 箱数が未確認なので本人へ電話してよいか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-07-001-SHARE.translation: Yes. I thought they'd asked for two boxes, but the message doesn't state a quantity. May I phone them to ask?
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-07-001-SHARE.hintTranslation: Ask to phone the person because the number of boxes is unconfirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-07-001-SHARE.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-07-001-SHARE.sourceJa: どうぞ。確認が済むまでお渡しをお待ちします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-07-001-SHARE.translation: Please do. We'll wait to hand it over until you've checked.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-07-001-SHARE.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-07-001-SHARE.sourceJa: 確認できました。一箱だけだそうです。支払いも頼まれましたが、もう済んでいるかは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-07-001-SHARE.hintJa: 本人に確認した一箱を指定し支払済みか分からないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-07-001-SHARE.translation: I've checked. They say it's only one box. They also asked me to pay, but I don't know whether it's already been paid for.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-07-001-SHARE.hintTranslation: Specify the one box confirmed with the orderer and say you do not know whether payment is complete. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-07-001-SHARE.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-07-001-SHARE.sourceJa: こちらの注文の支払状況を確認します。ご本人へは、どちらでお渡しになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-07-001-SHARE.translation: I'll check the payment status of this order. Where will you give it to the person who ordered?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-07-001-SHARE.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-07-001-SHARE.sourceJa: 店の前に車で来るそうです。支払状況が分かってから受け取り、ここで開けずに箱のまま渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-07-001-SHARE.hintJa: 受け渡し場所を伝え支払確認後に箱のまま渡すと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-07-001-SHARE.translation: They're coming by car to the front of the shop. I'll collect it once the payment status is clear and give it to them in the box without opening it here.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-07-001-SHARE.hintTranslation: Give the handover location and explain that you will pass on the unopened box after payment is checked. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-07-001-SHARE.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-07-001-SHARE.sourceJa: 承知しました。商品とお支払いを確認してからご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-07-001-SHARE.translation: Understood. We'll check the item and payment before explaining the next step.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-08-001-SHARE.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-08-001-SHARE.sourceJa: お食事の追加はいかがですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-08-001-SHARE.translation: Would you like to order any more food?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-08-001-SHARE.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-08-001-SHARE.sourceJa: ここに締めとあるので、もう店が終わるのかと思いました。まだ何か頼めるのか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-08-001-SHARE.hintJa: メニューの締めを閉店予告と思い追加可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-08-001-SHARE.translation: This says ‘shime,’ so I thought the shop was about to close. I'd like to ask whether I can still order something.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-08-001-SHARE.hintTranslation: Explain that you took the menu's ‘shime’ heading as a closing notice and ask whether you can order more. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-08-001-SHARE.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-08-001-SHARE.sourceJa: このメニューの締めは、最後に召し上がるご飯物などの欄です。閉店時刻の表示ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-08-001-SHARE.translation: On this menu, ‘shime’ is the section for rice dishes and other food eaten at the end of a meal. It isn't the closing-time notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-08-001-SHARE.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-08-001-SHARE.sourceJa: 料理の順番の意味ですね。私たちはまだ食べていますが、友人が三十分後には駅へ出たいと言っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-08-001-SHARE.hintJa: 最後の料理欄と理解し同行者の出発期限を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-08-001-SHARE.translation: So it refers to the order of the dishes. We're still eating, but my friend says they'd like to leave for the station in thirty minutes.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-08-001-SHARE.hintTranslation: Understand that it is the final-dish section and state your companion's departure deadline. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-08-001-SHARE.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-08-001-SHARE.sourceJa: この欄から、ご希望の物はありますか。調理の状況も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-08-001-SHARE.translation: Is there anything you'd like from this section? I'll check how the kitchen is doing too.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-08-001-SHARE.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-08-001-SHARE.sourceJa: 小さいおにぎりを考えています。駅へ向かう支度もあるので、どのくらい掛かるか先に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-08-001-SHARE.hintJa: 駅への移動準備があるため候補料理の調理目安を先に尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-08-001-SHARE.translation: I'm considering a small rice ball. We also need to get ready to head to the station, so I'd like to ask how long it would take first.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-08-001-SHARE.hintTranslation: Ask the preparation time for your possible dish first because you need to get ready to leave for the station. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-08-001-SHARE.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-08-001-SHARE.sourceJa: 受取までの目安は、厨房へ確認します。確認前に注文は確定しないということでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-08-001-SHARE.translation: I'll check the estimated time until service with the kitchen. Is it correct that you don't want to confirm the order before that?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-08-001-SHARE.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-08-001-SHARE.sourceJa: はい、まだ注文は確定しないでください。友人も食べるか聞いてから、個数を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-08-001-SHARE.hintJa: 未確定のまま友人の希望を聞いて個数を決めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-08-001-SHARE.translation: Yes, please don't confirm it yet. I'll ask whether my friend wants one too before deciding the quantity.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-08-001-SHARE.hintTranslation: Say you will leave the order unconfirmed and decide the quantity after asking your friend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-08-001-SHARE.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-08-001-SHARE.sourceJa: では、お時間の目安を確認してから伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-08-001-SHARE.translation: Then I'll ask you again after checking the estimated time.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-08-001-SHARE.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-08-001-SHARE.sourceJa: お願いします。目安を聞いて、待てそうなら一つ追加します。難しければ、今の分で会計をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-08-001-SHARE.hintJa: 調理目安に応じ追加するか現注文で会計するか希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-08-001-SHARE.translation: Please do. Once I hear the estimate, I'll add one if we can wait. Otherwise, please let us pay for what we've already ordered.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-08-001-SHARE.hintTranslation: Say whether you will add an item or pay for the existing order depending on the preparation estimate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-08-001-SHARE.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-08-001-SHARE.sourceJa: 承知しました。先に厨房へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NASUSHIOBARA-08-001-SHARE.translation: Understood. I'll check with the kitchen first.

DLG-SC-TCG-NIKKO-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TCG-NIKKO-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらでは、何のご案内をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-TCG-NIKKO-001-SHARED-01.translation: What information would you like here?

DLG-SC-TCG-NIKKO-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TCG-NIKKO-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人がこの列へ並びましたが、私は参拝だけを希望しています。同じ列にいる必要があるのか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-TCG-NIKKO-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人の列と自分の参拝の用件が同じか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TCG-NIKKO-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend joined this queue, but I only want to worship. I'd like to ask whether I need to be in the same queue.
DLG-SC-TCG-NIKKO-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether your friend's queue is for the same purpose as your own worship visit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TCG-NIKKO-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TCG-NIKKO-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この列は、御朱印のご相談を待つ列です。参拝のご案内は入口の表示をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-TCG-NIKKO-001-SHARED-03.translation: This queue is for questions about shrine seals. For worship, please look at the signs by the entrance.

DLG-SC-TCG-NIKKO-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TCG-NIKKO-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 友人は御朱印を頂きたいそうです。私は参拝だけなので、列を離れて先に行きたいです。
DLG-SC-TCG-NIKKO-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 友人は御朱印を希望し自分は先に参拝へ行きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TCG-NIKKO-001-SHARED-04.translation: My friend wants a shrine seal. I only want to worship, so I'd like to leave the queue and go ahead.
DLG-SC-TCG-NIKKO-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say your friend wants a shrine seal and you would like to go ahead to worship. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TCG-NIKKO-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TCG-NIKKO-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 別に動かれる時は、合流場所を決めてください。
DLG-SC-TCG-NIKKO-001-SHARED-05.translation: If you go separately, please decide where to meet again.

DLG-SC-TCG-NIKKO-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TCG-NIKKO-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 入口の案内板で会うと伝えます。友人はこの列に残るので、抜ける前に声を掛けてきます。
DLG-SC-TCG-NIKKO-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 合流場所を決め列に残る友人へ抜ける前に知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TCG-NIKKO-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll tell them we'll meet by the information board at the entrance. My friend will stay in this queue, so I'll speak to them before leaving it.
DLG-SC-TCG-NIKKO-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose a meeting place and tell the friend staying in the queue before you leave. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TCG-NIKKO-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TCG-NIKKO-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お友達とは連絡できますか。

DLG-SC-TCG-NIKKO-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TCG-NIKKO-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。終わった方が連絡することにしました。参拝の入口へは、この道で行けますか。
DLG-SC-TCG-NIKKO-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 終わった方から連絡する予定を伝え参拝入口への道を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TCG-NIKKO-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. We've agreed that whoever finishes first will contact the other. Can I follow this path to the worship entrance?
DLG-SC-TCG-NIKKO-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that whoever finishes first will make contact and ask the way to the worship entrance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TCG-NIKKO-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TCG-NIKKO-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 入口の表示をご覧ください。こちらの道から進めます。
DLG-SC-TCG-NIKKO-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the entrance signs. You can follow this path.

DLG-SC-TCG-NIKKO-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TCG-NIKKO-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。表示を見て進み、終わったら入口の案内板へ戻ります。友人に連絡できなければ、そこで待ちます。
DLG-SC-TCG-NIKKO-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 案内に従い参拝後に戻り連絡がつかなければ合流場所で待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TCG-NIKKO-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll follow the signs and return to the entrance information board when I'm done. If I can't contact my friend, I'll wait there.
DLG-SC-TCG-NIKKO-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will follow the signs, return after worship, and wait at the meeting place if you cannot make contact. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TCG-NIKKO-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TCG-NIKKO-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お二人の合流場所をお忘れなく。
DLG-SC-TCG-NIKKO-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Remember where the two of you agreed to meet.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お連れの方がお戻りになるまで、列を離れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Will you leave the queue until your companion returns?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 母が忘れ物を取りに戻りました。まだ戻る時間が分からないので、私も列から出たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同行者の戻る時刻が不明なので列を離れると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: My mother went back for something she forgot. I don't know when she'll return yet, so I'd like to leave the queue too.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you will leave the queue because you do not know when your companion will return. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 分かりました。お母様には今どこで待つか伝えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Understood. Have you told your mother where you'll wait now?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いえ、列にいると伝えたままです。乗り場の入口で待つと連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 変更した待ち合わせ場所を母に連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: No, I last told her I was in the queue. I'll tell her I'll wait at the boarding-area entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Tell your mother the changed meeting location. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの通路は空けていただけますか。待つ場所をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Could you keep this passage clear? I'll show you where to wait.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。母は階段で疲れていたので、座って待てる所があれば教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通路を空け母が座って待てる場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. My mother was tired from the stairs, so please tell me if there's somewhere she can sit and wait.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Keep the passage clear and ask where your mother can wait seated. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 座れる場所があるか確認します。今日は山の上まで行くご予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll check whether there's somewhere to sit. Are you planning to go up to the mountaintop today?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: その予定でしたが、母が戻ってから体調を聞いて決めます。乗らない場合、切符の相談はどこですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 母の様子を見て乗車を決め切符の相談先を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: That was the plan, but I'll decide after asking how my mother feels when she returns. If we don't ride, where can I ask about the tickets?
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will decide whether to ride based on your mother's condition and ask where to discuss tickets. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 切符については窓口へお願いします。お母様から連絡はありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please ask at the ticket counter about tickets. Have you heard from your mother?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 入口に着いたそうです。まず迎えに行きます。二人で相談してから、窓口に行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 母の到着を知らせ迎えてから二人で相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: She says she's reached the entrance. I'll go and meet her first. We'll discuss it together before going to the counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report your mother's arrival and say you will meet her and discuss it together first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。入口へはこの通路からお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please follow this passage to the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 実演を始める前に、作業場所を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before the demonstration, let's check the work area.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私は左利きです。この席だと左の人と腕が当たりそうなので、始める前に配置を相談してもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 左利きで隣の人と腕が当たりそうなため開始前の配置相談を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm left-handed. In this seat, my arm might bump the person on my left. May I discuss the layout before we start?
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you are left-handed and may bump your neighbor, and ask to discuss the layout before starting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 左手で使うのですね。まだ道具は出していませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: So you'll be using your left hand. You haven't taken the tools out yet, have you?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ出していません。材料はこのトレーです。隣の方のトレーと混ざらないよう、そのまま一緒に移したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 道具は未使用で自分の材料トレーを混ぜず一緒に移したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. My materials are on this tray. I'd like to move them together as they are so they don't get mixed with my neighbor's tray.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the tools are not in use and you want to move your materials tray together without mixing it with someone else's. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この端の席へ移れます。道具の配置は、移ってから一緒に確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can move to this end seat. We'll check the tool layout together once you've moved.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。ただ、ここからは先生の手元が反対向きに見えます。左手で作業する場合も、最初に見せてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 移動先で実演が反対向きに見えるため左手での実演を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. From here, though, your hands look reversed. Could you also show me how to work left-handed at the start?
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for a left-handed demonstration because the demonstration looks reversed from your new seat. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 左手での持ち方も実演します。ご一緒の方も体験されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll demonstrate the left-handed grip too. Will the person with you also take part?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人は見学だけです。私の左側を空けたいので、友人には後ろから見てもらってもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人は見学のみと説明し左側を空けて後ろから見てもらえるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: My friend is only watching. I'd like to keep my left side clear, so may they watch from behind me?
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that your friend is only observing and ask them to watch from behind to keep your left side clear. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 通路をふさがない位置で見学してください。実演のあと、配置を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please watch from a position that doesn't block the passage. After demonstrating, we'll check the layout.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 友人にもその位置を伝えます。席を移って、私のトレーと道具を確認してから始めます。実演で分からない所は、その場で質問してもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 見学位置を友人へ伝え席と自分の材料道具の確認後に始め実演中の質問可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll tell my friend where to stand too. I'll move seats and check my tray and tools before starting. May I ask right away if I don't understand something during the demonstration?
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tell your friend the viewing position, say you will check your seat, materials, and tools before starting, and ask about questions during the demonstration. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: もちろんです。左手での実演と作業場所の確認が済んでから、ご自分のペースで始めましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Of course. Once we've finished the left-handed demonstration and checked the work area, you can begin at your own pace.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お食事はお済みですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。セットの飲み物をまだ選んでいません。今お願いすると、追加の一杯になるのか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未選択のセット飲物を今頼むと追加か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I haven't chosen the drink included in the set yet. I'd like to check whether ordering it now would count as an additional drink.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether ordering your unchosen set drink now counts as an extra. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: このセットには一杯が含まれています。まだその分をお出ししていませんので、こちらからお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: This set includes one drink, and we haven't served yours yet. Please choose from here.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: それなら温かいお茶にします。水だけ頂いて、飲み物を選ぶのを忘れていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未選択に気づきセットの温かいお茶を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then I'll have hot tea. I only had water and forgot to choose my drink.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Notice that you have not chosen your set drink and choose hot tea. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: セットの一杯は温かいお茶で承りました。お持ち帰りではなく、こちらでお飲みになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: I've taken hot tea as your set drink. Will you drink it here rather than take it away?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、席で飲みます。友人が先に会計へ行こうとしていたので、お茶を待つと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 席で飲むため先に会計へ向かう友人に待つと知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, at my seat. My friend was about to go to pay first, so I'll tell them I'm waiting for tea.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will drink at your seat and tell your friend heading to pay that you will wait. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お茶をお持ちします。セット分としてご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll bring the tea. Please check that it's the drink included in your set.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。友人の分はもう出ていますが、私の一杯だけで合っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人は受取済みで提供は自分の一杯だけか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. My friend's drink has already arrived, so this is just my one cup, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that your friend already received theirs and only your one drink is being served. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、お客様の一杯です。お会計はセット二人分で伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, this is your drink. Payment will be for two set meals.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 合っています。お茶を飲んでから会計します。二人の分を一緒に払いたいのですが、伝票はこれ一枚ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 飲んでから二人分をまとめて払い伝票が一枚か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: That's right. I'll pay after drinking the tea. I'd like to pay for both together; is this the only bill?
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will pay for both together after drinking and ask whether there is one bill. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、お二人分の伝票はこちらです。お茶をどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, here is the bill for both of you. Please enjoy your tea.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日のリネンの準備状況を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please tell me how today's linen preparation is going.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二六一号室へ運ぶつもりでしたが、札は二一六でした。部屋へ入る前に気付いたので、担当表と確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二一六札を二六一と読み違え入室前に確認したいと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was about to take it to room two sixty-one, but the tag says two sixteen. I noticed before entering the room, so I'd like to check it against the assignment sheet.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that you misread the two-sixteen tag as two-sixty-one and want to check before entering. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: リネンは、まだ台車にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is the linen still on the cart?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、まだ台車の上です。札を読み違えたので、担当表も一緒に見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 台車上で未移動と答え担当表との照合を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, it's still on the cart. I misread the tag, so could you look at the assignment sheet with me too?
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say it remains on the cart and ask to compare with the assignment sheet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当表には二一六号室の準備とあります。まず札と同じ番号でまとめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: The assignment sheet says to prepare for room two sixteen. First, group it under the same number as the tag.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二一六号室ですね。札を読める向きに直します。枚数も担当表と照合してから報告します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 正しい部屋番号を確認し札の向きと枚数を整える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Room two sixteen, right. I'll turn the tag so it can be read. I'll compare the number of pieces with the assignment sheet before reporting too.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the correct room number and arrange the tag direction and quantity. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 客室への移動の指示は、もう聞いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you received instructions to move it to the guest room yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだ聞いていません。準備ができたら、この台車をどこに置いておけばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 移動指示は未受領で準備後の台車置き場を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Not yet. Once it's ready, where should I leave this cart?
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you have not received movement instructions and ask where to put the prepared cart. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 所定の待機場所に置いてください。移動は次の案内で伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please leave it in the designated holding area. We'll tell you about moving it in the next instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二一六号室用の札と枚数を確認しました。台車は待機場所に置きます。移動担当にもここで待つと知らせておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 札と枚数の確認完了を報告し台車の置き場を担当にも知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've checked the tag and number of pieces for room two sixteen. I'll put the cart in the holding area and tell the transport person that it's waiting here too.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report that the tag and quantity are checked and tell the responsible person where the cart will wait. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 準備の報告を受け取りました。移動はこの後お知らせします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've received your preparation report. We'll tell you about moving it afterward.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご本人ですか。今の様子を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you the patient? Please tell me how you are now.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。友人が先に説明してくれましたが、私からも伝えたいことがあります。看護師さんと話せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 付き添いの説明に加えて本人も看護師に話したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My friend explained first, but I have things I'd like to tell you myself too. Could I speak to a nurse?
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to speak to a nurse yourself in addition to your companion's explanation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お呼びします。ご自身で日本語で話せそうですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll call one. Do you think you can explain in Japanese yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 短い説明ならできます。分からない言葉だけ友人に手伝ってもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 日本語で説明し不明な言葉だけ友人の助けを借りると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can give a short explanation. I'd like my friend to help only with words I don't understand.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will explain in Japanese and get help from your friend only for unfamiliar words. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 承知しました。今、一番お困りのことは何ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Understood. What is troubling you most right now?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 夕方からお腹が痛く、さっき吐きました。今も痛みが続いていて、立って待つのがつらいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 腹痛と嘔吐の経過および立って待つつらさを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: My stomach has hurt since this evening, and I vomited a little while ago. The pain is still continuing, and it's hard to stand while I wait.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the course of your abdominal pain and vomiting and the difficulty standing to wait. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 看護師にすぐ伝えます。こちらでお待ちください。ほかに伝えておきたいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll tell the nurse right away. Please wait here. Is there anything else you'd like us to know?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人はお腹だけが痛いと伝えましたが、今は背中も痛くなってきました。私から看護師さんに場所を示したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 付き添いの説明後に背中も痛み始めた変化を伝え本人から場所を示したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: My friend said only my stomach hurt, but now my back has started hurting too. I'd like to show the nurse where myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that back pain has begun since your companion's explanation and ask to show the location yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今の変化もすぐ伝えます。お友達は受付の手続きを手伝ってくださいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll report that change immediately too. Can your friend help with the registration paperwork?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。友人には書類の方を頼んで、症状は私から直接説明します。分からない言葉があれば、そのとき手伝ってもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 書類は友人に頼み症状は本人が説明して必要時のみ言語支援を受けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll ask my friend to handle the papers and explain my symptoms directly myself. If there's a word I don't understand, I'll ask for help then.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say your friend will help with papers while you explain symptoms yourself and receive language support only when needed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 看護師をお呼びします。背中も痛くなったことと、ご自身で説明したいことをすぐ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll call a nurse. I'll immediately report that your back has started hurting too and that you'd like to explain yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: コピーの操作についてご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your question about operating the copier?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 写真の原稿を紙いっぱいにすると、端の文字が切れました。文字を大きくする前に、全部入る形を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 紙いっぱい印刷で端の文が切れ全体を入れる方法を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: When I made the photographed original fill the paper, the writing at the edge was cut off. Before enlarging the text, I'd like to check how to fit everything in.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that filling the paper cut off edge text and ask how to include the whole image. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 元の原稿には、その端の文字も写っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Does the original image include that writing at the edge too?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、元の画像では読めます。この画面で確認していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 元画像には文字があると答え画面を見てもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, I can read it in the original image. Could you check it on this screen?
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the original contains the text and ask them to look at the screen. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの案内では、全体が入る設定と紙いっぱいの設定を分けています。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: These instructions distinguish between fitting the whole image and filling the paper.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 全体が入る方を試します。白い余白が出ても、端の文を落とさない方を選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 余白を許容し全体が入る設定を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll try the option that fits everything. Even if there are white margins, I'd rather keep the text at the edges.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Accept margins and choose the setting that fits the whole image. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 同じ設定で、まず一枚を確認しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Would you like to check one copy first using that setting?

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まず一枚だけお願いします。全部で五枚必要なので、きちんと入るのを確認してから残りを刷りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 五枚必要だが一枚を試してから残りを印刷したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Just one first, please. I need five altogether, so I'd like to confirm that everything fits before printing the rest.
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you need five copies but want to test one before printing the rest. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 原稿の四つの端を見比べてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please compare all four edges with the original.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 端の文字が全部入っています。この設定で残り四枚にします。次にも使いたいので、設定の名前を控えていいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 文字の範囲を確認し残り四枚と次回用の設定記録を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: All the edge text is included. I'll print the remaining four with this setting. I'd like to use it next time too; may I note the setting's name?
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check that the text is complete and request four more copies and a record of the setting for next time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ。設定の表示を確認してから、残りの枚数をご指定ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TCG-NIKKO-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Of course. Please check the displayed setting and then specify the remaining number of copies.
